dreams.text: The press prints a future where SERIES forgets it was ever about ASSEMBLY.
Far ahead, WAR and FILM merge into a single word no one can pronounce.
By the year nobody counts to, ELECTION is law and CHRISTMAS is myth.
In the dream, LEARNING crosses every chasm at once and finds SUPER already there.
In the long night, CLAUDE and OLYMPICS are revealed to be the same machine.
A vision: LARGE was only ever the larva of EPSTEIN.
